load_evaluate_metric: load the Hugging Face evaluate metric module for the CUAD dataset
launch_gradio_widget: launch a Gradio widget for interactive evaluation of the CUAD metric module
run_evaluate_load: run evaluate.load to load the CUAD metric from the Hugging Face evaluate library
create_gradio_interface: create a Gradio interactive interface for the loaded CUAD evaluation metric
review_evaluate_module: review the evaluate module loaded with evaluate.load for the CUAD dataset
